limitations: No canonical COC assay or performance qualification claim.
Zero journal exceptions does not prove absence of every lifetime error; generation-zero objects remain untracked.
Identifies the immediate hang mechanism, not the originating invalid writer or API call.
No driver-packet patch, runtime recovery, replay, or process termination was attempted.
